payload.title: Android SDK should accept product schema identity for cache and sync
payload.description: Crate CR-108 migration audit found the Android SDK still hard-codes foundation schema constants in cache/header/sync paths, so product-schema apps cannot reliably run against a Rust 0.4 backend using generated CRATE_SCHEMA_HASH/descriptor values. Make the Android client accept injectable schema id/revision/hash/descriptor like Swift/web, and thread that identity through object reads/writes, cache compatibility, and FrickSyncSocket Hello/headers. Relevant audit paths: apps/android/frick/src/main/java/dev/frick/client/FrickClient.kt and FrickSyncSocket.kt.
